sections.label: D
sections.title: Write the words in the correct order to make sentences.
sections.note: Use every word and add correct punctuation.

questions.prompt: 1. start / my / weeks / school / new / in / three / I'll
answers: I'll start my new school in three weeks
I'll start my new school in three weeks.
questions.explanation: Place the subject and will first, followed by the verb, object, and time phrase.

questions.prompt: 2. will / She / arrive / Friday / on
questions.explanation: Use subject + will + base verb + time phrase.

answers: Harry won't go to the library tonight

answers: Sandra will celebrate her birthday tomorrow

questions.explanation: Use subject + will + base verb + object + time phrase.

sections.label: E
sections.title: Complete the sentences. Use will or won't.
sections.note: Choose the form that makes the meaning logical.

questions.prompt: 1. I'm feeling sick, so I ___ go to school tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Feeling sick gives a reason not to go, so use won't.

questions.prompt: 2. The Earth ___ orbit the sun in 365 days.
questions.explanation: Use will for this future statement.

questions.prompt: 3. Sheila is almost ten years old. She ___ be ten in three days.
questions.explanation: In three days describes a future fact, so use will.

questions.prompt: 4. Look! The sky is blue! It ___ rain today.
questions.explanation: The clear blue sky supports the negative prediction won't rain.

questions.prompt: 5. Tomorrow the sun ___ set at 7:40 p.m.
questions.explanation: Use will for the stated future time.

questions.prompt: 3. It ___ in the mountains tomorrow.
questions.explanation: The picture shows snow in the mountains, so use will snow.

questions.prompt: 4. She ___ tennis next year.
questions.explanation: The picture indicates that she will not play tennis, so use won't play.
